jobs.title: Staff Product Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Product Operations exists to give product teams the systems, data, and processes they need to plan, prioritize, and deliver well — the same way Sales Ops supports Sales or DevOps supports Engineering. This role sits at the center of that discipline, contributing to three core areas: the reporting and analytics that give everyone visibility into what's happening, the process that makes planning and delivery repeatable instead of reinvented pod by pod, and the ongoing work of keeping strategy and execution connected as priorities shift. We run Product Operations as a hybrid centralized/embedded model: some Product Ops work sits centrally and serves every product team consistently, while other Product Ops work sits embedded inside individual product lines, close to their day-to-day priorities. This role sits in the centralized hub — you're the shared systems, process, and reporting engine that every embedded product manager and product ops partner relies on, rather than being dedicated to any single product line. We're a small team, so this role is intentionally broad. At larger companies, "owns the tools," "owns the reporting," and "owns the process" are sometimes split into two or three separate roles. Here, one person does all of it, with the flexibility to shift emphasis as priorities and team size change over time. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling Infrastructure
jobs.description_text: About the Role We’re looking for a Software Engineer, AI Tooling Infrastructure to join our AI Tooling team and help build and run the backend services behind Supabase’s AI products. The Supabase MCP server is one example of what the team runs in production, alongside the services that support agent skills and the dashboard assistant. You’ll work closely with the Platform, SRE, Auth, Billing and Edge Functions teams, and with the engineers on the AI Tooling team who build the product surfaces. The AI Tooling team runs its own services in production and carries its own on-call. Traffic from AI clients and agents behaves differently from traffic from people: hundreds of calls a minute, retry loops, and no reading of deprecation warnings. This role makes sure the services they use are reliable, correctly authorized and observable. It is a systems and infrastructure role rather than a product AI role, and it is not an SRE role. You will build and operate these systems, not only advise on them. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments, owns what they ship in production, and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. jobs.description_text: About the Role We’re looking for a Product Manager, Administration & Governance to join our Product Team and make Supabase the default starting point for software built inside a company. Supabase already spreads from the bottom up: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. Inside most companies, Supabase starts the same way: someone has an idea, creates a project, and builds something useful. The next step is making that momentum company-wide: one platform where anyone can start building, and where IT can see what’s running, who owns it, and what it costs. You’ll own how companies run Supabase as their internal development platform: approved by IT and easy for anyone in the company to use. You’ll make it possible for people and the agents they work with to start building without waiting on infrastructure, while giving platform, IT, and security teams the controls they need to say yes. The goal is to make the approved path the easiest path, from an early experiment to a production application, with the controls companies need built in. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Own the product strategy and roadmap for internal innovation, from a company’s first IT-approved rollout to adoption across teams and business units. - Make getting started self-service, whether someone creates a project in Supabase, through an internal developer portal, or with an agent. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description_text: ABOUT TESSERA LABS Tessera Labs is a new category of enterprise software: an AI platform that changes how the world's largest companies run. Every large enterprise carries the same weight — decades of accumulated process, data, and code that no longer match the business it has become. Changing any of it is a program measured in years and hundreds of millions of dollars, staffed by armies of consultants, and it fails more often than anyone admits. Most companies have quietly accepted this as the cost of being large. We don't. Tessera is a transformation engine: a governed, multi-agent platform that understands an enterprise's process, data, and code as one connected system and changes it in weeks rather than years. We're vendor-agnostic by design — SAP, Salesforce, Workday, Oracle, Snowflake, MuleSoft — and tied to none of them. Two things make this hard, and they're the reason the job is interesting. Governance: every action is logged, traceable, and reversible, because our customers are regulated and these are the systems that close their books. And generality: the platform has to work on landscapes it has never seen, at companies whose complexity is genuinely unique to them. We sell a product, not a service. Our people are here to make the product successful, not the other way around. If you've watched enterprise AI companies quietly become consultancies, that distinction is the one to press us on. jobs.description_text: YOUR MISSION We're seeking a Principal Product Manager to help advance our Agentic Automation vision by giving enterprises the means to see, trust, and govern every agent they run, whether it runs on UiPath or somewhere else. Your scope spans three connected areas. Traces and observability capture the end-to-end record of what an agent did, what it cost, which model and configuration it used, and why. Those traces are the single source of truth for what happens across the UiPath platform, covering agents and every service that joins our trace infrastructure. Agent identity establishes who owns an agent, who it acts for, and what it's allowed to do. Governance ties the two together, and you'll be the Agents team's bridge to UiPath's broader platform governance. Across all three, you'll help define patterns the industry is still inventing, including OpenTelemetry for agents, cross-platform trace exchange, delegated permissions for agents, and policy and audit for non-deterministic systems. This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You won't be running status meetings. You'll be deep in the product: reading traces, prototyping with coding agents, talking with customers and FDEs, and turning what you learn into crisp direction for the engineers who build it. SALES・社内チームのサポート SFDCデータに修正が必要な場合の関係部署との調整 Salesや他部署からのイレギュラー案件等の相談への対応 3. プロセス改善・GLOBALプロジェクト Globalチームと連携した業務自動化プロジェクトへの参加 請求・レポート・データ処理に関する業務改善のサポート レポートやシステム機能の改善に関する要件整理・テスト 業務手順書・ポリシー・プロセスドキュメントの更新 4. その他のFINANCIAL OPERATIONS業務 週次・月次・Ad-hocレポートの作成 請求・回収状況や関連データの確認 Internal / External Auditに向けた資料準備・プロセス確認 その他、チームの状況に応じたFinancial Operations業務 応募資格 必須要件 経理業務、その他バックオフィス関連業務で社内外の関係者をサポートした経験 細かなデータ入力・照合・確認作業を、正確かつ継続的に行えること Salesや他部署からの依頼内容を確認し、必要な修正や関係者との調整を行えること Microsoft Office、特にExcelの基本操作スキル 自分で状況を確認し、必要な相手へ確認・相談しながら業務を進められること 歓迎要件 Salesforceの利用経験 SAPの利用経験 経理業務、請求書発行、Billing、受発注、売上管理、売掛金管理などの経験 英語を使ったメール、チャット、資料確認、Globalチームとの業務連携経験 業務改善、システム導入、データ整理、自動化プロジェクトへの参加経験 ※経理・会計の専門知識、大学・学部・学歴、英語力は必須ではありません。業務を通じて学ぶ意欲があれば歓迎します。 Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job?

jobs.title: Partner Sales Executive - Financial Crime Compliane
jobs.description_text: YOUR MISSION As a Partner Sales Executive focused on Financial Crime Compliance (FCC), you'll navigate partner ecosystems, building strong executive relationships, trust, and new revenue streams through value-based selling. You'll grow revenue and drive adoption of the UiPath platform for FCC use cases — such as anti-money laundering, KYC, and fraud — by partnering with world-class consulting and service organizations, and build the plans that help those partners deliver maximum success for their financial services customers. This is a unique overlay role: you'll drive partner sales for FCC across the entire company, and no two days will look the same. You'll build offerings and go-to-market strategies — and see them through to execution — with sophisticated, non-transactional partners such as global systems integrators and advisory firms.
